title: Peptides from the Intestinal Tract of Breast Milk-Fed Infants Have Antimicrobial and Bifidogenic Activity.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded source review opened XML/PDF, extracted PDF text, OA package NXML/supplement PDF text, packet database snapshots, and merged sequence catalogs. No blocking local material gap remains for worker-4/6 adjudication.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed the prior framework-test ticket: Table 2 supplies all 33 candidate-peptide MIC values with units and targets, database rows reconcile to primary sequences/values through Table 2 plus merged sequence catalogs, and mechanism claims are retained as phenotypic rather than direct molecular mechanism evidence.
summary: Worker-4/6 re-review accepted the paper with cautions after source-backed row reconciliation. The final artifacts preserve high-MIC/phenotype-only caveats and close rwk-complete-test-0001 with no open publication-grade blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material extraction remains complete-with-gaps at the packet layer because the packet noted analysis rework, but XML, PDF text, OA NXML, supplementary PDF text, and database snapshots were available for the worker-4/6 repair.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural contract remains usable; this repair adds source-reviewed final artifacts rather than relying on packet existence or validator success alone.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 33 DBAASP assay rows, 33 duplicated DBAASP experiment rows, 11 CAMP entry-text rows, and 11 DBAASP literature rows were reconciled to Table 2 sequences/values or article metadata. Empty packet sequence snapshots were recovered from merged sequence catalogs.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity now contains the 11 x 3 Table 2 MIC matrix with raw values, µg/mL units, target species/strains, and source locators. Result-text growth-promotion and CFU claims are recorded as supporting claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is limited to phenotypic antimicrobial/growth-modulation evidence and candidate-selection context; no direct mechanism claim is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Prior rework causes are resolved; remaining caveats are nonblocking cautions, not targeted rework tickets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The packet-local linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty; sequence checks were completed from primary Table 2 plus merged sequence catalogs.
CAMP linked rows combine all three organism MIC values in one text field, so final database audit preserves entry-level granularity while source-linking each target value.
The source discussion characterizes these MICs as weak relative to lactoferricin; raw MIC values are preserved rather than normalized to potency categories.
The paper reports OD600/CFU growth phenotypes and candidate-selection correlations, not a direct molecular target or membrane mechanism assay.
The supplementary PDF contains known bioactive peptide inventory and candidate-selection flow diagrams; no structured supplementary activity table changes the Table 2 MIC adjudication.
